the triple helix is essential for frameshifting, although not sufficient for high efficiency frameshifting.
the pseudoknot is not only a necessary, but also a sufficient factor for −1 frameshift.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the triple helix is essential and that its role is to provide a structural framework that allows the slippery sequence to be recognized.
a triple helix is not a prerequisite but a major determinant for frameshifting efficiency.

the frameshifting signal of SRV- 1 is highly structured and that the triple helix is essential for efficient frameshifting.
